question: Can the unchanged twenty-parent mesh contract complete under a measured 2-GiB runner-plus-executor process-tree RSS hard limit?
method: Start wholly from the sealed C13-C15 parent manifests, not V1/V1R assets. Generate the same twenty native meshes and sanitation audits and ten train-only previews while psutil samples the runner plus recursive descendants every 0.25 seconds; SIGINT and FAIL on RSS above 2 GiB.
baseline: V1R corrected checkout propagation but was stopped at observed 1,243,852 KiB executor RSS because its approved RAM budget was 1 GiB; all V1/V1R partial assets remain excluded.

user_authorization.scope: One immutable V1R2 batch from sealed topology only: twenty native meshes, twenty sanitation audits, ten train-only previews, a 2-GiB process-tree RSS hard limit and trace; zero LiDAR, teacher, samples, training, models, C09/C10 or M-TARE; no V1/V1R reuse.
user_authorization.confirmation_reference: User explicitly replied '批准' after the exact V1R2 20-parent, 2-GiB measured process-tree RSS, <=2 CPU-hour and <=1 GiB disk scope passed all non-authorization checks.

resource_contract.definition: Sum of psutil RSS for the runner process and all live recursive descendants.
resource_contract.on_rss_exceed: SIGINT executor, mark FAIL and seal partial evidence without reuse.

acceptance_criteria: Exactly twenty frozen parent identities reconstruct in sealed order with unchanged topology and geometry seeds.
Exactly twenty primary meshes and sanitation audits pass; all mesh hashes are unique.
Exactly ten corrective-train complete previews and zero validation previews are created.
Measured process-tree peak RSS is <=2147483648 bytes, duration <=7200 seconds and result <=1073741824 bytes.
All downstream and forbidden-world counters remain zero and V1/V1R assets remain unread.
stop_conditions: Any authorization, tool, source seal, environment, identity, order, split or seed drift.
Any process-tree RSS sample above 2147483648 bytes, timeout, disk excess, mesh/sanitation failure, validation preview or downstream operation.
Any read, resume or reuse of V1 or V1R partial assets.
expected_evidence: Twenty mesh assets, sanitation records and per-parent metrics; one mesh manifest.
Ten train-only maps, raw log, process-tree RSS trace/summary, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal.

estimated_cost.compute: Serial CPU in exact Cano E1; zero GPU, LiDAR, teacher or model.
